contentList.content: Its in that cave over there
Hey, help me get my lute back.
Its deep in the cave behind me.

Hmm, maybe you can assist me. If you confront him with me, he will be so scared that he hands the lute back! HAHA! Full proof plan! I have some treasures from my village that I could give you for your troubles. How does that sound?
Aye, if you're here for a song, I can't play you one. If not, piss off.
You bastard! You can't get a man's hopes up and then spit and stomp on it. Bug off then. If you actually care, then come back and find me. No good travelers, not good for anything.

AHAHA! You're one of the good ones, I see! Well then, I last remember seeing him and his band wandering around northwest of the crash site. While we travel, I want to get your thoughts on a potential song I am working on!
He called my music bad and took her from me! That fleabag doesn't know music if it BIT HIM IN THE ARSE!
Upset?! Well, my lutes been stolen; my dearest Betsy has been ripped from my arms by an ugly, nasty, bugbear.
Well, if you had the day I've HAD? You'd be upset too. Though, you do look and smell quite bad, that appears to be a normal thing for you lot.

Head North West to where Dafodil Brokenstring last saw Trexels party heading
Search for the nearby cavern entrance
Claim the lute from Trexels body
ahh...oof...I must of gotten nicked by one of those goblins... Got me pretty good. I think you'll have to go on without me...
Oh shut it. Great musicians can create music without their instrument and I have a good set of pipes. I saw some of them scurry off toward that cave. Must be where ol'betsy is!
I will stay out here... healing my wounds... If you die I will find someone else to help me get my lute.
T-they got me good...Please head in...We must get Betsy. I will be fine...hopefully...now GO!
You lot will be fine! I hurt myself walking all the way over here. Now go in and I will go get your reward.
Hmm...left his henchmen for us to deal with... Well I saw some of them run into that cave there. Maybe he's inside.
Aha! We did it! You guys did great! Never douvted you for a second. This could make for a great song...

N-no! Save yourselves for the final fight, a battle of the ages! Once I am recovered, I will be right here! To sing my song and destroy any foe that may sneak upon you all! GO! Before the fiercesome Treasure Trekel makes his grand escape!
Can't make music without a lute.
We are here for the lute.
LUTE?! From... mean bard? bard bad! he hurt ears. we stop it.
His voice is bad, but not THAT bad!
If you want lute, we fight! GOBLINS! Attack!
His voice bad. Other people say it, I help them. Now trophy in room!
Where are goblins? What you do?!
You KILL them?! You now DIE!
You lie! Me no like liars, DIE!
By the gods...You lot are alive! Do you have Betsy?!

OH BETSY! MY LOVE! Thank you all, thank you! I shall repay you with a gift of my people. A powerful artifact that can cause some great chaos. My family loved Chaos, and you all fit the mold. Before I hand you the artifact, I must say you were all inspirations for my legendary song! Want to hear it?
Really? Are you sure? It is one of my finest works... you guys are in it....
Bah! So be it! Just remember, when I become famous, you lot will be nobodies to me! Now piss off!
Really?! You mean it! Oh, what joy! I was told nobody would ever want to hear me sing, but here we are! Curse you mother! Alright, everyone, brace yourselves fore what I call "the song for the ages!"
The song is so bad, we cannot play it for the player or write the lyrics out as it will cause the player blindness and to become hard of hearing.
Search the inside of Trexels cavern
Confront Trexel and put and end to his rampage
Speak to Dafodil Brokenstring about the lute
